project_type: FastAPI backend (Python 3.11) + Cloudflare Workers edge (TypeScript) + React frontend
build_system: pnpm monorepo with pip for Python backend. No Makefile. pnpm workspace with apps/edge, apps/frontend, apps/backend.
test_framework: pytest with httpx AsyncClient for backend (apps/backend/tests/conftest.py), vitest for frontend/edge
verification_instructions: 1. Run ruff check apps/backend/app/ to verify no lint errors. 2. Run pytest apps/backend/ with test env vars. 3. Run pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit for edge type checking.
setup_instructions: 1. pip install ruff pytest httpx. 2. Strip hashes from requirements.txt and pip install. 3. pnpm install for edge/frontend.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Can install packages and run builds. No Docker daemon available for full container builds.
contribution_requirements: Standard GitHub flow. Conventional commits. Lint with ruff, tests with pytest.
key_patterns: Singleton pattern for service clients (module-level instances). Beanie ODM for MongoDB models. Pydantic settings for config. AsyncClient from httpx for HTTP calls. FastAPI routers for API endpoints. Redis used for rate limiting, token blacklisting, caching.
directory_structure: Monorepo: apps/backend (FastAPI), apps/edge (CF Workers), apps/frontend (React). .github/workflows/ for CI/CD. infra/ for IaC. scripts/ for tooling.
